data.sql: SELECT "st"."station_type" AS "station_type", SUM("s"."energy_kwh") AS "charging_volume_kwh", ROUND(SUM("s"."charging_duration_seconds") / (86400.0 * SUM("st"."connector_count")), 4) AS "station_utilization_rate" FROM "semantic_sqlbot_charging"."fact_charging_session" "s" JOIN "semantic_sqlbot_charging"."dim_station" "st" ON "s"."station_id" = "st"."station_id" WHERE "s"."settlement_time" >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00' AND "s"."settlement_time" < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY "st"."station_type" ORDER BY "st"."station_type" LIMIT 500
